name: FREE T3
description: Free T3 measures unbound triiodothyronine levels and evaluates thyroid function in specific clinical scenarios. This test assesses the most biologically active thyroid hormone and helps diagnose T3 toxicosis.

testdetails.instrumentation: Abbott Architect, Roche Elecsys, Beckman Coulter

literatureReview: Free T3 (FT3) measures unbound triiodothyronine, the most biologically active thyroid hormone. Normal range 2.0-4.2 pg/mL. FT3 is less commonly ordered than FT4 or TSH but useful in specific situations. High FT3 with normal/low TSH suggests T3 toxicosis or thyroid hormone resistance. Low FT3 indicates hypothyroidism or non-thyroidal illness. Chemiluminescent immunoassay provides excellent sensitivity. T3 has shorter half-life than T4 and responds more quickly to thyroid status changes. Used in evaluation of amiodarone-induced thyrotoxicosis, TSH-secreting pituitary tumors, and monitoring T3 replacement therapy. Results complement TSH and FT4 for comprehensive thyroid assessment.
